description.value:
A fine hand-shake under pressure.

Gift — The shake reads as harmless: +1 circumstance to Deception to appear feeble, drunk, or no threat. Tithe — −1 circumstance to fine-work checks (Thievery, surgery, Crafting detail passes) while in an encounter or observed.

cinderfall.incomplete: "−1 circumstance to fine-work checks (Thievery, surgery, Crafting detail passes) while in an encounter or observed" has no clean predicate: 'observed' and the 'fine-work'/'detail pass' subsets of Thievery and Crafting have no standard action-slug (unlike Climb, Swim, or Escape), so scoping the penalty correctly isn't possible without either missing the restriction or over-penalizing all Thievery/Crafting checks.
